# Capstone Quest Academy

> Pre-Kindergarten for children ages 3 to 5, with sites in Tucson and Yuma,
> Arizona. Independently owned, operating since 2013, Arizona state licensed and
> approved by the Arizona Department of Economic Security (DES). Open Monday to
> Friday, 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM, year round. Bilingual site; Spanish-speaking staff
> at both locations.

Capstone Quest Academy publishes its full weekly tuition schedule, its parent
handbook, and its enrollment and care policies as web pages rather than
downloads. Most preschools in this market publish none of these.

Capstone Quest Academy is an independent, privately owned business. It has been
housed in AmeriSchools Academy campuses since 2013, but it is not a division,
campus or program of AmeriSchools Academy.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://capstonequestacademy.com/): Overview of the Pre-K program, both locations, and how to book a tour.
- [Tuition and fees](https://capstonequestacademy.com/tuition): Complete weekly rates — $130 five-day, $120 three-day, $160 five-day including before and after care. Before- and after-care priced separately. No registration fee and no deposit. Includes the Barr Family Early Learners Scholarship, which covers up to 50% of fees for families DES declined.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://capstonequestacademy.com/faq): Cost, hours, ages, toilet training, DES assistance, meals, ratios and tours, answered directly.
- [Programs](https://capstonequestacademy.com/programs): What the Pre-K year covers for ages 3 to 5.
- [Tucson site](https://capstonequestacademy.com/campuses/tucson): 1150 North Country Club Road, Tucson, AZ 85716. (520) 462-7788.
- [Yuma site](https://capstonequestacademy.com/campuses/yuma): 1220 South 4th Avenue, Yuma, AZ 85364. (928) 977-9318.
- [Parent handbook](https://capstonequestacademy.com/handbook): Philosophy, admissions, registration and refunds, health and medication, emergency procedures and discipline.
- [Policies](https://capstonequestacademy.com/policies): Enrollment, release and care policies, including suspension and expulsion.
- [Schedule a tour](https://capstonequestacademy.com/tour): Book a 30-minute tour at either location, on a live calendar.
- [Enroll](https://capstonequestacademy.com/enroll): Enrollment is on paper. Download the packet for your location, complete one per child, and return it to the registrar.
- [Why us](https://capstonequestacademy.com/why-us): What distinguishes the program.
- [About](https://capstonequestacademy.com/about): History and approach.
- [Parents](https://capstonequestacademy.com/parents): Information for enrolled families, including menus and the documents families are given.
- [Contact](https://capstonequestacademy.com/contact): Location contact details.
- [Accessibility](https://capstonequestacademy.com/accessibility): WCAG 2.2 Level AA conformance statement.
- [Privacy](https://capstonequestacademy.com/privacy): What the site collects and why.

## Key facts

- Ages served: 3 to 5 years. Children under 3 cannot be accepted.
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM. Instructional day 8:00 AM to 3:30 PM.
- Operates year round for Pre-K. Summer camps for ages 6 to 12.
- Adult-to-child ratio: 1 to 13.
- Licensed by Arizona: Tucson CDC-17293, Yuma CDC-17301.
- Quality First participating program (Arizona First Things First).
- DES child care assistance accepted. Families may start before approval and are refunded retroactively to the DES effective date once approval lands.
- Barr Family Early Learners Scholarship: covers up to 50% of preschool fees for families who did not qualify for DES. Established in 2023 by the Barr family, founders of AmeriSchools Academy and Capstone Quest Academy.
- Meals: breakfast and snacks provided; families pack lunch.
- Children must be independently toilet trained before their first day.
- No registration fee, no supply fee, no deposit.
- Tours are booked online at /tour and run about 30 minutes.
